integrity: The infinite law and square-root coefficient asymptotic are proved analytically. Standalone finite-step exact-rational verification is not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive backtracking and forward weights, infinite d-regular tree with d>=3. This is an exact probabilistic first-return computation; possible overlap with unexamined infinite-volume weighted-resolvent specializations is acknowledged. A full independent priority audit has not occurred.
title: An exact first-return law and a backtracking-invariant conditional mean on regular trees
